CustomField.description: The applicant's answer on a reciprocity application to whether they got their out-of-state license by apprenticeship, experience or online training rather than at a licensed or certified school. Licenses obtained that way are not accepted for reciprocity, so a Yes stops the application.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Yes if the out-of-state license was obtained by apprenticeship, experience or online training rather than at a licensed or certified school.
CustomField.label: License By Apprenticeship
